text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, sorting that data took way too long...
Huh? ...What's that sound?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What the heck are you doing at this hour?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I was pumping air into the ball.
We are going to play basketball at our class social tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...All the balls around here?
No way you're gonna need that many for some social gathering."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Someone will end up using it eventually, so I figured I'd take care of it while I was at it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well then... I'll get back to work.
Excuse me, Shakur-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! About halfway left, I guess...
Alright.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, Shakur...!? Since when were you—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh. It bounces really well, just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Checking the bounce.
Hurry up and pass it over."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You can handle at least that much, right?
Your old man's a basketball coach, after all."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes!
That's why I like it quite a bit! Basketball, that is!

Having thoroughly enjoyed herself, Air Messiah seemed
to have grasped something...
From then on, her movements were noticeably sharper.
